basic_info_description: FURNISHED or UNFURNISHED Single Family Home in San Francisco for Rent!   Summary:  Rent: $21,000 (Unfurnished - 1 Year+terms)  $23,000 (Furnished - 6-12+ month terms)  Bed/Bath: 5bd / 3.5ba  Type: Single Family Home  A Fantastic Pacific Heights Home located at Alta Plaza Park! This unique property, with its early century San Francisco charm, features: classic furniture and artwork, bay windows, great hardwood floors and a fantastic backyard. On the first floor, youll find an exquisite living room with decorative fireplace, a formal dining room, bathroom and a gourmet kitchen that opens to your lush backyard. Upstairs  the master bedroom, three additional bedrooms, and an amazing walk-in closet. In the lower level of the property an additional office, bedroom, living room and the laundry room. This space is perfect for guests, a nanny or if you work from home. Ideally located in one of SF's finest neighborhoods, and in close proximity to Fillmore and Divisadero St, you'll find wonderful boutique shopping, dining and entertainment venues - all a part of your new San Francisco experience! Youll also find that Mollie's Stones supermarket is conveniently close to home and even offers a free shuttle service. Easy access to public transportation will get you Downtown in no time at all  just simply hop on the 1-California, 3 blocks from the house!   2 entrances - main entryway, and private lower level entrance Upper level features 4 of 5 total bedrooms Master bedroom features: walk-in closet, dual-vanity sink, claw-foot tub, stand up shower stall, and marble tile Kitchen features: full-range, stainless steel stove/oven, additional family/dining room and direct access to deck and backyard Hardwood flooring throughout, Marble tile in master bath, Carpet in Family room and bedrooms Upper level has two full bathrooms; Main level has half-bath; Lower level has one full bath with shower over tub Private deck and lush backyard Decorative Fireplace for candles or home decor Additional family room, office and bedroom on lower level Laundry room with washer/dryer 1-car parking included Directly across the street from Alta Plaza Park Considered a "Walker's Paradise" at Walk Score, so daily errands do not require a car. 97 restaurants within a 15 minute walk, including: Mehfil Indian Cuisine, Stag Dining, Tataki Sushi and Sake Bar. and so much more! Plenty of shop/boutiques and nightlife on Divisadero St and Fillmore St. Nearby transit includes: MUNI - 24-Divisadero, 3-Jackson, 10-Townsend, 1-California, 22-Fillmore
